description: On-device Meshtastic messaging with the LoRa-1262 Cap

store.summary: Send and receive Meshtastic messages with your CardputerZero.
store.description: Use the built-in keyboard for channel messages and direct messages. Browse nearby mesh nodes, see the Cap's GNSS position, and manage radio and channel settings. Requires the M5Stack LoRa-1262 Cap. The mesh radio runs while the app is open.
